label: Reconstruction from public reporting
description: Dividend payment instruction (corporate action instruction) as entered into the system, April 2018. Reconstructed only from publicly reported figures.
event: April 2018: a cash dividend of 1,000 won per share to employee shareholders was entered as 1,000 shares per share and approved; 2,812,950,000 shares that did not exist were credited to 2,018 employee accounts.

fields.name: cash_dividend
fields.evidence: Reported: the 1,000 won per share dividend was keyed in as 1,000 shares per share (the instruction that was approved).

fields.name: declared_cash_dividend
fields.evidence: Reported: the dividend actually declared was 1,000 won per share.

fields.name: eligible_shares
fields.evidence: Reported: employee-held shares receiving the dividend (2,812,950 x 1,000 = 2,812,950,000 shares issued in error).

fields.name: shares_outstanding
fields.evidence: Reported: about 89 million shares outstanding (the ghost shares were ~31x this).
